description: This file implements HTTP response writer with content encoding (gzip and zlib) support, including methods for writing, flushing, closing, and hijacking connections, as well as handling content encoding negotiation.

classes.name: CompressingResponseWriter
classes.description: A custom HTTP response writer that supports content encoding (gzip and deflate), with methods for writing, flushing, closing, and hijacking.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Returns the header map that will be sent by WriteHeader.

methods.name: WriteHeader
methods.description: Writes the HTTP response header with the given status code.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the compressor, which encodes it before sending.

methods.name: CloseNotify
methods.description: Returns a channel that receives a notification when the connection has gone away.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes any buffered data to the client.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the compressor and releases resources.

methods.name: isCompressorClosed
methods.description: Checks if the compressor is already closed.

methods.name: Hijack
methods.description: Allows connection hijacking, useful for websockets.
